prompt: Some people say that computers have made life easier and more convenient. Other people say that computers have made life more complex and stressful. Discuss both side and give your opinion
essay:
It is often claimed that computers have made people’s lives easier because of their convenience, while others believe that they have created more complexity and pressure by making people constantly accessible and enabling fraud to occur more frequently. However, I believe that their benefits outweigh these disadvantages.

From one perspective, computers have removed traditional barriers, making people accessible almost at any time. This can negatively affect employees because managers may contact them outside working hours, increasing their workload and stress. Furthermore, computers have made fraud more widespread through fake websites and online accounts, which can be difficult to distinguish from legitimate ones. For example, fraudsters may create websites that imitate well-known businesses and persuade customers to enter their banking information, resulting in financial losses. Nonetheless, I believe these concerns are outweighed by the advantages.

From another perspective, computers allow people to perform numerous activities conveniently , regardless of time or location. Individuals can search for information and study without visiting a library, book trips and appointments, apply for jobs , and even work from home. They have also transformed shopping and business, allowing people to purchase products online or establish businesses without a physical store. For instance, the Saudi website Salla enables small businesses to create online stores and sell their products or services from home, reducing the costs associated with opening a physical branch.

In conclusion, although computers can increase stress by making people constantly reachable and can make fraud easier to conduct, I believe that their advantages are greater, as they allow people to complete a wide range of personal and professional activities more conveniently.
